chapter_name: Maintain Healthy, Safe and Secure Working Environment
learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to maintain workplace safety, identify hazards, follow emergency evacuation procedures, practice ergonomics, and promote environmental conservation!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: एर्गोनॉमिक्स (कार्यस्थल पर शारीरिक सुविधाओं का विज्ञान)
निकासी / आपातकाल में सुरक्षित बाहर निकलना

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Hazards can be Physical (slippery floors, trailing cables, fire), Chemical (toxic fumes, cleaners), Biological (bacteria/viruses), or Ergonomic (poor seating, screen glare).
Setting up your workstation correctly to prevent Repetitive Strain Injury (RSI): screen at eye level, back supported, feet flat on the floor, and taking regular eye/wrist breaks.
Knowing fire alarm locations, emergency exits, and assembly points. Use fire extinguishers following the P.A.S.S. technique: Pull pin, Aim at base, Squeeze lever, Sweep side to side.
Maintaining clean restrooms, pure drinking water, proper lighting, and an accessible, fully-stocked First Aid box for minor injuries.

fun_activity.title: 🪑 Ergonomic Desk Check
fun_activity.instructions: Sit at your study table right now. Is the top of your screen at eye level? Are your elbows at a 90-degree angle? Adjust your chair height so your feet rest completely flat on the floor!

exam_tips: 📌 Know the P.A.S.S. acronym for using a fire extinguisher (Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep)—it is a very common exam question.
📌 List at least 3 ways to prevent electrical hazards in a computer lab (no overloaded sockets, no frayed wires, keeping liquids away).
📌 Define Ergonomics clearly as the science of designing the workplace to fit the worker's physical needs.
quick_recap: ⭐ All emergency exits must be kept completely clear of boxes or obstructions at all times.
⭐ The 20-20-20 rule (every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds) prevents digital eye strain.
⭐ Every organization must conduct periodic fire drills so occupants know exactly how to evacuate calmly.
